title: Loading States — skeletons + spinners SSOT
description: One configurable LoadingSkeleton component with per-kind presets (text, card, list, table, form, page, block) composed on top of the shadcn Skeleton primitive, plus a spinner-based LoadingState (inline / block / overlay) for in-flight work where a skeleton would be wrong. Drop the page kind straight into a route loading.tsx; count and columns are overridable per use. The SSOT that replaces ad-hoc animate-pulse divs and hand-rolled Loader2 spans.
